stalkBindings_left_signal_hold.title: Stalk: Left signal (held)
stalkBindings_left_signal_hold.desc: On while the button is held, off when it's released; a quick flick flashes 3 times. For indicator stalks that latch.

stalkBindings_right_signal_hold.title: Stalk: Right signal (held)
stalkBindings_right_signal_hold.desc: On while the button is held, off when it's released; a quick flick flashes 3 times. For indicator stalks that latch.

stalkBindings_signal_cancel.title: Stalk: Signal cancel
stalkBindings_signal_cancel.desc: The indicator stalk's middle position: stops the indicator (or finishes a flick's 3 flashes).

stalkBindings_lights_on.title: Stalk: Lights on
stalkBindings_lights_on.desc: Turns the lights on (low beam, or high beam with the stalk pushed).

stalkBindings_lights_toggle.title: Stalk: Lights toggle
stalkBindings_lights_toggle.desc: Turns the lights on or off.

stalkBindings_highbeam_hold.title: Stalk: High beam (held)
stalkBindings_highbeam_hold.desc: High beam while the button is held, with the lights on.

stalkBindings_highbeam_on.title: Stalk: High beam on
stalkBindings_highbeam_on.desc: Stalk pushed to high beam: lit while the lights are on.

stalkBindings_highbeam_toggle.title: Stalk: High beam toggle
stalkBindings_highbeam_toggle.desc: Switches the high beam on or off, with the lights on.

stalkBindings_highbeam_flash.title: Stalk: High beam flash
stalkBindings_highbeam_flash.desc: High beam while held, lights on or off.

stalkBindings_fog_hold.title: Stalk: Fog lights (held)
stalkBindings_fog_hold.desc: Fog lights while the button is held.

stalkBindings_fog_toggle.title: Stalk: Fog lights toggle
stalkBindings_fog_toggle.desc: Switches the fog lights on or off.

stalkBindings_cc_onoff.title: Stalk: Cruise on / off
stalkBindings_cc_onoff.desc: Holds the current speed, or switches cruise control off and forgets the set speed.

stalkBindings_cc_resume_up.title: Stalk: Cruise resume / +
stalkBindings_cc_resume_up.desc: Resumes the set speed, or raises it: a tap by 1, held on to the next 5.

stalkBindings_cc_set_down.title: Stalk: Cruise set / -
stalkBindings_cc_set_down.desc: Holds the current speed, or lowers it: a tap by 1, held on to the next 5.

stalkBindings_cc_cancel.title: Stalk: Cruise cancel
stalkBindings_cc_cancel.desc: Pauses cruise control, keeping the set speed to resume.
